svg.title: Stop at the wall, learn every run
svg.desc: Start cheapest tier with a record → Log one line per check attempt → Stop 3 fails, idle, or 90% of time → Escalate keep what passed, send the rest up → Record class, model, result, quota · After 5 samples: ≥ 90% done moves a class down a tier, < 60% moves it up. You approve each change.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
